page.overview:
Who is Ninja Rats?

The Ninja Rats are a boss in the sewers level of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2: Battle Nexus. Unlike their 2003 TV series , they each wear a mask color that matches those worn by the . They also are capable of speaking English, or at least in a language communicable to the Turtles. They are led by a .

The Ninja Rats are also competitors in the Battle Nexus tournament, being aided by four .
